main_text.p: Ἑλλὰς fuit : vt non fine ratione, ficuti Roma δῆμος τῆς οἰκουμένης,& pop. Rom. δῆμος τῆς οἰκουμένης à Polemone oratore,vt referunt Galenus & Athenæus, vocatus est : ita Athenæ Ἑλλάδ[?] δήμῳ Ἀθηναίων[?] populus Athenienfis δῆμος τῆς Ἑλλάδος dici potuerit.

Propterea ait Menáder apud Alciphronem in epistola ad Glycerâ,videre fe ἐν ταῖς Ἀθήναις τὴν Ἑλλάδα ὅλην, τῷ Ἰωνίᾳ,ἕως Κυκλάδας πάσας[?]. Rectéque meo iudicio & verè Philo Iudæus, ὥσπερ ἐν ὀφθαλμῷ κόρη ἢ ἐν ψυχῇ λογισμὸς, τὸ ἐν Ἑλλάδι Ἀθῆναι[?]. Cæterum περὶ τῆς τῶν τρόπων οὐσίας[?] egregius est Theophrasti noftri locus,quem defcripfit & nobis cóferuauit Porphyrius in libro ii[?] περὶ ἀποχῆς ἐμψύχων[?]. Diligens lector ibi requirat:nobis enim is liber nunc ad manum non eft:qui ista recenfemus non per otium in museo,fed ὁδὸς παρέργων ἐν ἀπορίᾳ[?], omnibus studiorum præsidiis destituti.
Pag. 2. καὶ βιβλιοκῶς.] Malim , ἄτε βιβ. vel ἄτε καί. Locum subobscurum dedimus operam vt planum versio redderet.

Ἔτη ἐννενήκοντα ἐννέα[?].] Ita legitur etiam in antiquis quatuor codicibus Palatinæ bibliothecæ. memini etiam in Ioannis Tzetzæ Chiliadibus hunc locum ita defcriptum reperire, & fimiliter annos centum vno dempto attribui Theophrafto hunc librum fcribenti.Quod etfi mirum eft, propter tot auctorum filentium, qui longæuos philofophos recenfuerunt: poteft tamen vnius faltem teftis, eiufque admodum ἀξιοπιστίᾳ[?], auctoritate defendi. Ait enim Hieronymus in epiftola ad Nepotianum, Vnde & sapiens vir Graciæ Theophrastus,(ita omnino fcribendum, non Themistocles) cum expletis centum & septem

page.notes: Greek passages are doubtful at many points and marked [?]; the Greek letters are copied as far as they could be read. The line-end dash after "centum" is unclear and was read as a line-end hyphen only tentatively. The running head "COMMENTARIVS" was printed with V and is given here as COMMENTARIUS per the u/v rule. Long s is written as s throughout. No catchword or signature visible. The commentary entries "Pag. 2." and "Ἔτη..." are set in full-width text, not margins, so they are main text.
